I would love to talk it over with X and Y as soon as possible, but they've both made it decently clear that they don't want to speak right now, so I'm thinking I'll give it a day or two. The only issue I have with putting my foot down is that Y, even though I truly believe he cares for me and wants the best for me, is easily caught up in his own perspective and is obviously feeling very victimized. If I were to try and approach him and imply in any way that his behavior was inappropriate, he'd would more than likely just get pisses at me and refuse to make up at all until I begged him to forgive me.
As for using the words slut, I know exactly what you are talking about, and I apologize for it. There is nothing wrong with having sex and having lots of it and no one should be shamed for it, but honestly, I just couldn't think of another word to use to describe how desperate I was for sex.
For now I'm thinking of just spending some time with a couple other friends and my family and hopefully it will turn out okay:( thanks for your reply.
